config.title: Kältehilfe Berlin - FAQ
config.subtitle: Who to call for someone sleeping out in the cold in Berlin, when the buses run, and what to donate.

items.q: When does the Kältehilfe in Berlin run?
items.a: The season runs from **1 October to 30 April**. The city plans about 670 emergency places in October and about 1,000 in the cold months from November to March.

items.q: What is the Kältebus number in Berlin?
items.a: The Kältebus of the Berliner Stadtmission is **030 690 333 690**, daily from November to March, 20:00 to 2:00. The Red Cross Wärmebus is **030 600 300 1010**, daily from November to March, 18:00 to midnight.

items.q: Who can I call in October, before the buses start?
items.a: The **Kältehilfetelefon, 030 343 971 40**, answers daily from October to April between 19:00 and 23:00. In Steglitz-Zehlendorf the DRK-Südwest Obdachbus answers on 0157 58 09 49 52 from 11:00 to 22:00. In an emergency, call 112.

items.q: When should I call 112 instead of the Kältebus?
items.a: When the person **does not respond, seems confused, lies still in the cold or could be in danger.** That is an emergency for the fire brigade and ambulance on 112, or the police on 110.

items.q: Should I call the Kältebus without asking the person?
items.a: No. Ask politely first whether they need anything. The Stadtmission asks callers to make sure the person wants their help, because a wasted trip delays help for someone else.

items.q: Where can women and families sleep?
items.a: Berlin has separate shelters for women, among them the **24/7 shelter on Hallesches Ufer**, and two family shelters, on Wrangelstraße in Kreuzberg and Am Bärensprung in Heiligensee, which take only adults with children. Phone first to ask whether places are free.

items.q: What should I donate, and where?
items.a: Clean, intact winter clothing, **new and unopened hygiene items, sleeping bags, fleece or wool blankets and sleeping mats.** The Stadtmission's Textilhafen at Storkower Straße 139 D takes up to five bags without an appointment, Monday to Friday 9:00 to 16:00 and Saturday 10:00 to 15:00.
